# `operation-tags-changed`

Operation tags changed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `sdk` |
| **Default severity** | `info` · `--profile sdk`: `warn` |
| **Rule IDs** | `operation-tags-changed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Paths and operations ([RULES.md section 2](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

The operation's tags changed (order doesn't matter).

## Why this default

Many SDK generators group methods into classes by tag, so the method moves to another class. The wire format doesn't change.

## Example

From test case [`operation-tags-changed`](../../test/cases/operation-tags-changed/): Changed tags are an sdk change.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
        operationId: listPets
        tags:
-       - pets
+       - animals
        responses:
          '200':
```

Findings:

- `operation-tags-changed` · info · GET /pets

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  operation-tags-changed: info
```

## How to fix

Keep the old tags if SDK compatibility matters.
